post.description:
Triggered when a Pay Out transaction (a payout) is voided or canceled.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_voidedcancelled`
Legacy notification name: `PayOutCanceled`

Triggered when a pay out transaction enters processing status.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_processing`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is processed.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_processed`
Legacy notification name: `PayOutProcessed`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is placed on hold.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_onhold`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is released from hold.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_released`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is recovered.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_recovered`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is initiated.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_initiated`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is authorized.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_authorized`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is approved and captured.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_approvedcaptured`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is declined.

On a failed capture, the payload includes a `Reason` field explaining why the capture didn't succeed.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_declined`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is declined due to technical reasons.

The payload includes a `Reason` field explaining why the capture didn't succeed.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_technicaldecline`

Triggered when a pay out transaction fails.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_failed`

Triggered when a pay out transaction encounters an error.

On a failed capture, the payload includes a `Reason` field explaining why the capture didn't succeed.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_error`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is paid.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_paid`
Legacy notification name: `PayOutPaid`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is returned.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_returned`
Legacy notification name: `PayOutReturned`

Triggered when a pay out transaction is rejected.

On a failed capture, the payload includes a `Reason` field explaining why the capture didn't succeed.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_rejected`

Triggered when Payabli's duplicate detection flags a pay out transaction as a potential duplicate. The payload identifies the affected transactions and the details of the anomaly.

Notification name: `payout_transaction_duplicated`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is pending.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_pending`

post.summary: Pay Out Batch Settlement In Transit
post.description:
Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is in transit.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_intransit`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is transferred.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_transferred`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is funded.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_funded`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is resolved.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_resolved`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement encounters an exception.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_exception`

post.summary: Pay Out Batch Settlement ACH Return/Chargeback
post.description:
Triggered when a pay out batch settlement has an ACH return or chargeback.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_achreturnchargeback`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is held.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_held`

Triggered when a pay out batch settlement is released from hold.

Notification name: `payout_batch_settlement_released`

Triggered when a pay out batch is funded (replaces payoutbatchfunded).

- Notification name: `payout_batch_funded`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchfunded`

Triggered when a pay out batch is processed (replaces payoutbatchprocessed).

- Notification name: `payout_batch_processed`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchprocessed`

Triggered when a pay out batch is paid (replaces payoutbatchpaid).

- Notification name: `payout_batch_paid`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchpaid`

Triggered when a pay out batch has funding pending (replaces payoutbatchfundingpending).

- Notification name: `payout_batch_fundpending`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchfundingpending`

Triggered when a pay out batch is opened.

Notification name: `payout_batch_open`

Triggered when a pay out batch is closed.

- Notification name: `payout_batch_closed`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchclosed`

Triggered when a pay out batch is not closed.

Notification name: `payout_batch_notclosed`

Triggered when a pay out batch is cancelled (replaces payoutbatchcancelled).

- Notification name: `payout_batch_cancelled`
- Legacy notification name: `payoutbatchcancelled`

Triggered when a pay out batch is transferred.

Notification name: `payout_batch_transferred`

Triggered when a pay out batch is resolved.

Notification name: `payout_batch_resolved`

Triggered when a pay out batch is placed on hold.

Notification name: `payout_batch_onhold`

Triggered when a pay out batch is released from hold.

Notification name: `payout_batch_released`

affectedIds.description: A JSON-encoded array, sent as a string, of the IDs of the transactions flagged as duplicates.

gateway.description: Identifier of the gateway associated with the affected transactions

duplicateCount.description: The number of transactions flagged as duplicates
